title: Tooling: accelerate exact seven-owner Fano replay with row tables
body:
The PR3168 verifier spends most of its time multiplying the same finite GF(2) row patterns. This opt-in adapter precomputes their exact right actions, preserving all 1,379,952 reduced triples, full 289-bit equality keys, relation words, Fano searches and the complete original receipt. No new bound, supplier or κ is claimed.

Three alternating fresh-process pairs on the same complete input measured:

| CPython | Original median | Tables median | Ratio |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| 3.12.14 | 21.44 s | 8.00 s | 2.68× |
| 3.13.5 | 20.72 s | 7.48 s | 2.77× |

Raw timings and memory, exact source/blob pins, the row/packing equivalence argument and a registered replay are included in `research/fano-census-row-tables/`.

Validation: every actual triple key agrees exactly with the original multiplication; every complete benchmark receipt matches the committed predecessor bytes. Seven test groups pass under Python 3.12 (normal and optimized) and 3.13, including a separate dot-parity oracle, four semantic mutants, source mutation/restoration and output-reuse controls. Package metadata, selected-source inventory and whitespace checks pass.

Reproduce:
```sh
python3 -I -B research/fano-census-row-tables/verify.py
```
Expected: `PASS_ALL_EXACT_TRIPLE_KEYS 1379952 rows 18388`, then `PASS_FANO_ROW_TABLES` with receipt hash `e33a4809ad6ec2025aa46ecb5b2f9d790295379d4794bd911e0b67cf7e6aa652`.

Commit: `209d20d9da025c90110465f9a1f18186a6160147`. Base: `463113d675af7410ac91d53a4fed51ec6494eb9a`; OS assignment seed 91, verification engineering. No pinned sprint issue existed; claim and overlap coverage are recorded locally. Frozen predecessors, `upstream/`, selected κ and default commands are unchanged. The ledger's partial-review status of #3097/#3168 is not promoted by this tooling result. Full supplier replay, repository-wide suites, Lean and hosted CI were not run; observation/representation/support and inherited multiplication interfaces remain assumptions.

Credit Sudarsh Chaturvedi's #3168 census/Fano verifier, Gonzalo Mier's #3097 support-seven work, Ross Richardson's chart-swap derivation, Aaron Wang/navinor, ywz65 and the cumulative selected supplier lineage. Prepared by Charan with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; no independent human review. Apache-2.0.
